# Vendored PDF.js

- Version: 6.4.299 (stable release, pinned)
- Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/releases/tag/v6.4.299
- License: Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`)
- Included runtime: generic display module and worker, CMaps, standard fonts, and WebAssembly/runtime support files.
- No source maps, demo PDFs, or generic viewer UI are included.

Third-party font and decoder notices are retained beside their assets (`standard_fonts/LICENSE_*`, `wasm/LICENSE_*`, and `cmaps/LICENSE`). The upstream release package is used without edits.
